title: Loop while a condition holds
objective: Use repeat while to run lines again for as long as a condition is true, and make sure the loop can finish.

body.text: repeat while checks its condition before each run of the indented lines. While the condition is true, the lines run again. As soon as it is false, the loop ends and the program continues below it. If the condition never becomes false, the program runs forever, so the lines inside must change something the condition depends on.

body.title: Count a score up to 70
body.code:
make changing score equal to 0
repeat while score is less than 70
    increase score by 10
say score

body.title: A countdown
body.code:
make changing fuel equal to 3
repeat while fuel is greater than 0
    decrease fuel by 1
    say fuel

body.text: A loop can also wait for the reader. Here the loop keeps asking until the reader types quit. The condition is checked before each ask, so the loop ends after the reply that makes it false.

body.title: Ask until the reader quits
body.code:
make changing command equal to "look"
repeat while command is not equal to "quit"
    set command to ask "command: "
    say command
say "exited"

body.prompt: The score stops climbing at 50, but it should reach 100. Make the program print 100.
body.starter:
make changing score equal to 0
repeat while score is less than 50
    increase score by 10
say score
body.solution:
make changing score equal to 0
repeat while score is less than 100
    increase score by 10
say score
